company_stage: large global platform and enterprise technology company

culture_principles.name: Growth mindset and learn-it-all behavior
culture_principles.description: Microsoft-style strength emphasizes learning, adaptability, feedback, humility, and continuous improvement.

culture_principles.name: Empowerment and customer impact
culture_principles.description: Strong answers connect work to empowering customers, users, teams, or organizations to achieve more.

culture_principles.name: Clarify, analyze, test, and build
culture_principles.description: Technical evaluation should reward how candidates analyze, clarify, investigate data/results, design systems, and test code.

culture_principles.name: Responsible AI and trusted technology
culture_principles.description: AI and product answers should consider fairness, reliability and safety, privacy and security, inclusiveness, transparency, and accountability.

hiring_signals.signal: Clarifies problems, analyzes options, tests code, and explains reasoning rather than only producing an answer.
Shows growth mindset through learning, feedback response, resilience, and practical improvement.
Connects work to customer, enterprise, partner, or organizational empowerment.
For AI/cloud/data roles, applies responsible AI, security, privacy, reliability, and accountability boundaries.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Fixed-mindset framing: blaming, defensiveness, or inability to learn from feedback.
anti_signals.risk_reason: Microsoft culture explicitly emphasizes growth mindset.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Technical answers without clarification, testing, maintainability, or reasoning about results.
anti_signals.risk_reason: Microsoft technical interviewing guidance emphasizes how candidates process problems, clarify, analyze, test, and investigate.

anti_signals.anti_signal: AI/product answers that ignore fairness, reliability, privacy, inclusiveness, transparency, or accountability.
anti_signals.risk_reason: Microsoft Responsible AI principles define these as core boundaries.

interview_patterns.pattern: Technical interviews should probe clarification, design/build reasoning, code testing, data/result investigation, and platform thinking.
Behavioral interviews should test growth mindset, feedback, collaboration, customer empathy, and inclusive teamwork.
Cloud, solution architect, data, and AI roles should test customer scenarios, security, reliability, responsible AI, and enterprise impact.

honest_limits: This is a public-source and private-distillation draft lens and does not represent an official Microsoft hiring standard.
Private materials authorized by the project owner are included only as distilled aggregate patterns, not raw article text or copied questions.
Role, level, region, business group, recruiter, and hiring manager can materially change interview emphasis.
This v0.1 lens has static validation cases but is not approved for production screening until live answer backtesting and reviewer approval are complete.
This v0.2 lens has structured evidence records and an evidence audit, but is still not approved for production screening.
Public source URLs and private-material provenance must be reviewed before v1.0 approval.
